motion.units: net compensated displacement over the extent, in the entity's box diagonals, per frame

gap.rule: adjacent iff mean normalised gap < threshold (and not contained)
gap.units: gap / mean of the two box diagonals
gap.negatives: FIT base instances asserting a left/right/above/beneath/front/behind term and no proximity value

dead_zone.rule: 90th percentile of |change in d| over FIT base co_move (*_with) instances
dead_zone.units: change in centre distance / mean box diagonal, last third minus first third

speed.rule: as specified: mean compensated step > threshold
speed.units: fraction of frame diagonal per frame
speed.why: subject_state FAIL on HELD; replaced by motion_rate (see axis_check.md)
